instruction.text: Read these instructions on how to make a periscope and drag them into the correct order.

elements: Firstly, fold a piece of cardboard in half, cut a circle in it and make slits on the side of the rectangle.
Secondly, make tabs along the sides and glue the tabs together.
Next, fold a sheet of paper into a cylinder and glue it to the cardboard.
Finally, glue the back of the mirror and place it at a 45-degree angle.

instruction.text: Read the text below and decide if the set of bullet points has summarised the text correctly.

atoms.text: The sunflower is a type of flower that is originally native to North and Central America with up to 70 different species. The sunflower’s scientific name is 'Helianthus' and its name comes from the Greek word 'helios' meaning 'sun'. A sunflower usually grows 6-10 feet tall, and it always turns to face towards the sun when it shines. Sunflower seeds are edible and are full of nutrients.
